title: SimulationAppEndpointInfo
description: Information about the network endpoint that you can use to connect to your custom or service app. For more information about SimSpace Weaver apps, see Key concepts: Apps in the SimSpace Weaver User Guide..

allOf.description: The IP address of the app. SimSpace Weaver dynamically assigns this IP address when the app starts.
The inbound TCP/UDP port numbers of the app. The combination of an IP address and a port number form a network endpoint.
